summary: Basel Medical Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a registered direct offering rather than a special situation. On October 7, 2026, the company signed a placement agency agreement with Cathay Securities Inc. and a securities purchase agreement with purchasers for 6,000,000 units at US$1.33 per unit, each unit comprising one ordinary share or one pre-funded warrant plus one common warrant. Gross proceeds were US$7.98 million and net proceeds approximately US$7.28 million, closing October 9, 2026, expanding shares outstanding from 1,582,111 to 7,582,111.
